verdict.rationale: The only support is Apple's marketing claim of "legendary power efficiency" for pros working on large video and AI files, plus battery-life figures (up to 24 hours, 22 hours video streaming). These hint at efficiency but say nothing about sustained render or export behavior. The community comment about an efficiency headline is skepticism about the benchmark choice, not a concrete contradiction, so it does not make this disputed. Missing for 10: documented power envelopes or TDP figures, sustained-load or throttling data for long renders and exports, independent performance-per-watt testing.
